name: living-city
vibe: A living neon skyline at night. A persistent, continuously-flowing city backdrop — a dusk sky gradient, a moon and a parallax starfield, a glowing horizon, two layers of building silhouettes with twinkling lit windows, a road band and drifting traffic light-streaks — runs unbroken behind every cut. Neon-sign titles glow over the skyline; screenshots appear as glowing holographic billboards on support poles; neon stat numbers light up like a district ticker; feature billboards line up with numbered labels; a logo-reveal CTA closes with a neon button. Everything is theme-driven, so the brand color repaints the whole city — the sky glow, the silhouettes, the lit windows, the traffic streaks, the billboard neon and the CTA, not just the text. Portrait-native 9:16 for Reels, Shorts and TikTok. Rendered as a native GSAP + canvas composition. Best for product launches, app/SaaS showcases, bold urban brands, screenshots and anything that should feel electric, cinematic and after-dark.
